name: Edu_visualization_benchmark
description:
Our dataset comprises a total of 1,154 problems, including 215 multiple-choice chemistry questions, 207 physics questions, 532 easy mathematics problems, 89 medium-difficulty mathematics problems, and 111 hard mathematics problems. Within the easy mathematics category, 373 are image-based questions, while the remaining 159 are text-based.
The chemistry questions are derived from the AI4Chem/C-MHChem-Benchmark-Chinese-Middle-high-school-Chemistry-Test dataset. Originally written in Chinese… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Lekr0/Edu_visualization_benchmark.
evaluation_method: accuracy (and exact_match for free-response where applicable)
reputation: A modest-sized educational multimodal benchmark curated for image-and-text school-level STEM problems; used primarily in small-scale research and education experiments.
